sanskrit_verse:
आज्यं विना यथा तैलं सद्भिः प्रतिनिधिः स्मृतम् ।
तथैकादश पुत्रास्तु पुत्रिकारसयोर्विना ॥
transliteration: ājyaṃ vinā yathā tailaṃ sadbhiḥ pratinidhiḥ smṛtam | tathaikādaśa putrāstu putrikāurasayor vinā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: As ghee is substituted by oil in the absence of ghee, so too eleven sons stand as substitute heirs in the absence of a daughter or adopted son.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through conscious designation, not biological necessity
Substitution arises from structural completeness, not emotional preference
Capacity for inheritance is determined by alignment with dharma-vyavastha, not lineage alone
Restoration of order requires functional replacement, not punitive exclusion
Consciousness alignment determines eligibility, not sentimental attachment
executable_legal_axioms: IF (lineage_heir IS ABSENT) AND (daughter IS ABSENT) AND (adopted_son IS ABSENT) THEN (eleven_sons ARE eligible_substitutes)
IF (functional_continuity IS required) THEN (substitute_heir_selection IS based_on_dharma_role_compatibility)
IF (inheritance_claim IS made) THEN (eligibility_algorithm INCLUDES consciousness_state_of_claimant)
IF (heir_structure IS incomplete) THEN (automatic_realignment_protocol INVOKES designated_alternate_lineage)
supreme_court_application: In matters of succession where natural heirs are absent, the court must recognize the pre-established substitution mechanism outlined herein. The authority does not lie in bloodline precedence but in the capacity to uphold dharmic continuity. Eleven sons assume the role automatically when neither daughter nor adopted son exists, ensuring societal and spiritual equilibrium without recourse to subjective valuation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This law reflects pramāṇa-based causality: the absence of primary heirs necessitates activation of secondary structures. It aligns with anupūrvaśaḥ—sequential unfolding of lawful consequence. Responsibility lies not in fault, but in the duty to maintain structural integrity. There is no punishment; only the realignment of roles according to dharma’s immutable sequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Acknowledge vacancy of primary heir and invoke substitute framework immediately upon verification.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Initiate formal declaration of substituted heir status within seven days of vacancy confirmation.
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Ensure substitute heirs receive necessary education/training to fulfill their roles within 100 days.
Integrity Reintegration Procedure: Conduct community affirmation ceremony to solidify consciousness alignment of new heir.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores order through substitution, not punishment. Reality responds to alignment, not retribution. Consciousness remains the ultimate judge and executor of truth.
